༄༅/ /rta 'bul dus rgya nag rgyal po la phul ba'i zhu yig/shrī sa gsum gyi 'chi med dbang po/mi'i rgyal por mnga' gsol zhing gling bzhi'i sa skyong 'a

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rta 'bul dus rgya nag rgyal po la phul ba'i zhu yig/ shrī sa gsum gyi 'chi med dbang po/ mi'i rgyal por mnga' gsol zhing gling bzhi'i sa skyong 'khor lo sgyur ba'i dpal ldan srid pa gsum gyi gtso bo rab mchog chos kyi rgyal po gong ma rin po che'i drung du/ stag tshang ba hu'u kya 'o waṃ nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bu/ shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing zhu ba/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dang / lhar bcas skye dgu kun gyi dpal mgon dam par gyur pa/ mi 'jigs gdong lnga pa'i gser gyi khri ga la ba der/ sku'i dkyil 'khor rnyog bral gzi 'od kyi mdangs dang ldan par bzhugs pa/ bdag sogs 'dzam bu gling pa'i lus can mtha' yas pa la mchog tu tshad med pa'i bka' drin chen pos bskyangs/ de ltar mtshon byed dus kyi zhu yig dang / 'bul rta 'dogs mi 'phral du rdzong ltar dgos rgyu lags gnang / bod yul stod smad kun tu hor sog lhag pa'i 'jigs pa dang / gtsang dbus kyi sa'i thig ler 'khrug long rgyun ring zhing / khyad par dpal sa skya'i khri thog na/ bdag gi khu bo ta'i chings hwa waṃ blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bzhugs pa dang / stag tshang du'ang bdag gi yab hu skya ho waṃ nam mkha' bkra shis pa gnyis 'char kyang gzhan don la dgongs pa sogs mi 'dod pa'i rkyen mang pos dbang med du rnam par g.yengs pas/ 'bul rta ba 'gyangs pa la/ thugs rin po che nam yang mi khrel ba mkhyen cing / deng sang gi gnas skabs su/ dpal ldan sa skya'i khri thog du bdag slebs/ gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas thos bsam bsgom gsum la nam yang brtson pa ma dor ba'i ngang nas/ nye lam chos kyi rje rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa shākya rgyal mtshan gyis btab pa'i chos grwa chen po dpal nā ren+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang du/

mdo khams stod smad dbus gtsang mnga' ris sogs nas gus pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag lhag pa la/ bdag gis dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa bshad nyan gyi rgyun btsugs nas ma nyams par yod pa dang / stag tshang phyogs su yang / srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i chos sde dang / rin chen sgang zhes pa'i 'dul ba'i grwa sa dgon gsar du btab nas/ slob dpon chen po ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gdan sar bkod/ zur 'chad bka' bcu pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / rab 'byams pa rab 'byor dpal ldan rnams kyi bshad nyan sgom bsgrub tshul bzhin du byed kyi yod cing / gzhan yang bod kyi sa'i cha la gtogs pa'i thub pa'i bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa gang na bzhugs pa thams cad la/ ji ltar 'os pa'i dbu 'don bdag rkyen legs par bgyis nas/ dpal ldan sa skyas thog grangs gtsug lag khang rnams zhig gso/ /sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs/ dgon gnas so sor rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod rgya chen po dang / mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan rgyun ma chad par byed pa sogs rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba tshad med par bsgrub pa 'di dag thams cad kyi dgos pa'i gtso bo/ /chos kyi rgyal po gong ma mi'i dbang po yab sras bskal pa'i bar du sku tshe brtan zhing / chab srid dar rgyas 'byung ba'i phyir/ dge 'dun rnams sku'i rim gro dang / smon lam bzang po rtse gcig tu 'debs par gnas lags pa de thams cad la mgon gnyer/ bdag rkyen dus rtag tu/ thugs brtse ba chen pos bzung du gsol/ yang gal che ba'i zhu don/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gong ma ta'i ming yun lo rgyal pos/ ti shrī'i las kha bzang po gnang 'dug pa bzhin bdag gi khu bo blo gros rgyal mtshan pa la ti shrī'i las kha gnang 'dug pa bzhin/ de'i srol khyud da lan bdag la ta'i chings hwa waṃ ti shrī'i las kha dang /

bdag gi yang mes nam mkha' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / pha nam mkha' bkra shis gnyis la yang / sngar khyud las kha gnang pas/ da lta bdag gi nu 'o nam mkha' 'dod grub tshe brtan bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po stag tshang gi khrims ra 'dzin gyi yod lags pas ho kya ho waṃ gi las kha/ ka ho ming / 'ja' sa sogs/ gong zhus dang phyogs gcig par/ bka' drin chen pos legs par skyong ba mkhyain/ ces pa'i zhu don bsgrub par grogs mched rnams rdzong ltar bgyis pa lags shing / zhu yig spyan ras 'tsho ba'i rten/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi gser sku legs pa gcig dang thub pa'i dbang po'i bris sku mtshar ba gcig dang / sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel yin nges pa bcu/ gser zho lnga rnams 'bul/ rab mdzes ke la sha yi lhun po ni/ /rab dkar bsil zer dra bas khebs pa bzhin/ /rab mchog 'chi med dpal gter lha mo yi/ /rab brtan chos kyi rgyal po dge legs mdzod/ /sgrol byed ces pa chu mo lug gi lo sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po nas phul ba dge legs rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /mnga' ris rdzong kha mnga' bdag rgyal po la gnang ba/ oṃ swasti/ dpal bkra shis dge legs rgyal bar gyur cig/ shrī dza yan+tu/ dge legs bye ba'i dpal yon rab tu brtan pa'i lugs gnyis nor bu'i khri la rtag 'khod nas/ mchog tu gzhan la phan pa'i thugs rje'i snang brnyan skye dgu'i mig gi bdud rtsi dal 'byor sku/ /yid 'ong mtshan dang dpe byad du ma'i rin chen do shal rnam par bkra ba'i rgyan gyi mdzes/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir thub bstan rgyas mdzad rigs gsum rnam 'phrul chos kyi rgyal po rtag tu rgyal/ /gang gi rigs dus gser gyi thig le'i chu gter che las nye bar 'khrungs pa'i dbang po gang / /lang tsho gsar pa'i 'dam skyes gzhon nu rnam dkar gnyis skyes ze'u 'bru'i ge sar cher gsal zhing /

/nam yang 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyi lo 'dab zur gyis lta ba'i 'dren byed zung gi ut+pal can/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dpal mgon de nyid lo brgya'i bar du zhabs brtan dge legs rgya cher stsol/ /de ltar bde legs byed pa'i tshigs bcad sngon du btang nas slar yang chos kyi rgyal po la/ /bas mthar gnas pa'i shākya'i dge slong skad gnyis smra ba sa skya pa zhes rab grags des/ /rnam par dkar ba'i yid kyi 'phrin du 'di skad gsol gyi khyed thugs ches cher dwangs pa yi/ /me long ngos la don gyi gzugs brnyan 'di dag rab tu gsal bar kun nas 'char gyur cig /sngon gyi smon lam bzang pos 'tshams sbyar rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag tu/ /nged kyi bla ma sa gsum 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan chos kyi rje btsun pa zhes gang / /snyan par grags pa'i bshad sgrub dri ma med la gcig tu dad pa'i thugs dang ldan ces thos/ /slad kyang de 'dra'i ngang tshul nyid la gnas par mdzod cig 'phral dang yun gyi bde legs 'phel/ /da lan don gyi snying po kho bo'i lhan cig gnas pa sangs rgyas shes rab grogs mched rnams/ /rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa mkhan chen zhabs kyi drung du na bza' sna grangs 'bul ba dang / /nges don zab mo'i chos kyi de nyid sgro 'dogs gcod phyir zhu ba'i don slad bzhud lags pa/ /gzhi dang lam du zas nor 'tsho ba'i yo byad stsol zhing dgra jag gnod pa med par mdzod/ /de ltar blo bzang pad mtsho las 'khrungs phrin gyi snyan ngag ut+pal phreng ba 'dis/ /legs par mngags pa'i pho nya ngang pa'i ded dpon mgul pa'i rgyan du byon nas phyogs der bzhugs/ /dri med spyan ras nye bar rten du ma hā tsih+na'i rgyal bu kha thags la/ /ka ka ma tsi'i khu bas phyag rgya bkod nas chu zla dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i tshes la bris/ /i daṃ pradz+nyā+o pā yau yu ga sat+kān+tā re ka l+yā ṇa li khi taṃ/ 'di thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i dgon pa nas dge bar bris//

༈ /glo bo mkhan chen pa la phul ba'i zhu yig/ swasti/ shri wāñdzā nen+d+ra ya s+ya pra shu tsi ka ru ṇa shī lorta ma twaṃ su rāṭ+su/ swasti/ dpal ldan ye shes dbang po khyod nyid thugs rje mchog dang rab tu gtsang ba'i khrims kyi legs par mdzes/ bi shrū tā ne ka ko ṣaṃ dha ra ba ra da bi muk+tā tsa ra dh+ya na tsit+ta/ rnam mang thos pa du ma'i mdzod mnga' rnam par grol ba'i mchog sbyin bsam gtan kun nas spyod pa'i thugs/ dhar+m+ma pra pañtsa ta twaṃ na wa ra ṇa su dṛ shā bhi dz+nyā gam+bhī ra bud+dhīḥ chos rnams spros pa med pa'i de nyid sgrib med legs gzigs mngon par mkhyen pa'i zab mo'i blo dang ldan/ sid+dhī shwar+ya pra bi dwan+sā na kha a ru ṇa rasmi dwa sā de pra ṇa mya/ rab tu mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug gang gi zhabs sen dmar ba'i 'od can la ni rtag tu 'dud/ bi ma la wa pu ṣa ni t+yaṃ me ru bar+dhā su war+ṇa/ gser gyi lhun po lta bu'i sku ni rtag tu dri ma med pa nyid/ su wa tsa mṛ du ka sā maṃ hangs shab+da bagho ṣa/ 'jam zhing snyan pas ngang pa'i sgra dbyangs ji bzhin legs par 'chad pa'i gsung / s+d+yi ra ma na pa ra mār+tham̐bo dha tu l+ya pra tsan+tī/ dam pa'i don rtogs yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i thugs ni sems can gyi/ ma ṇi i ti ra ti sa twār+tha shru te not+sa hāp+taḥ don la dges par bzhugs zhes thos pas rab tu spro ba thob par 'gyur/ ya s+ya ā dz+nyā bar+ṇa ma ṇa/ gang gi bka' yi nor bu'i phreng ba ni/ mā len+t+ra nī la tsai t+ya ka in+d+ra nī la'i mchod rten tog dang bcas/ sa ke tu shi raḥshrī dat+ta/ yan lag mchog gi dpal du rab byin pas/ tsit+tā na n+da pra me tu ya tu/ yid mi dga' ba dpag tu med par gyur/ a haṃ te pra sā do da dha/ bdag kyang khyed kyi bka' drin chu gter las/ r+yū ba nāb+dza sa dāradza ra/ lang tsho'i 'dam skyes nam yang ma rgud cing / ha sa sa mā dhi ke she rāṃ/ ting 'dzin ge sar kun tu bzhad pa las/

sha gan+dhāp+ta su bhā ṣa tu/ legs bshad dri bsung cha tsam khyab pa lags/ yub+ma ka nā tha na bha wān+ta yā bta/ slar yang mgon khyod srid mtha'i bar du yang /ka ya dh+wa dza pra s+d+yi ra tiṣ+ṭha kṛ twā/ sku yi rgyal mtshan rab tu brtan bzhugs nas/ /bin+t+wa tra wā kyo ba su dhā mṛ te na/ gsung gi bdud rtsis nor 'dzin thig le 'dir/ kar+m+mārkaka bhā sar+b+ba bhabaka pra kā shaḥ phrin las nyi 'od kun du gsal gyur cig āshīstathā tsihaṃsakaṇ+ya/ de lta'i shis brjod dad pa'i bu mo ni/ swādūrasīgan+dhasadeyashākhā/ dri zhim don ldan shing lo'i skyes dang bcas/ shrar+dhāmateḥshwetasamutragatāta/ rab dkar dad pa'i blo mtsho las 'phur nas/ baisul+yadharmas+yasabhasugats+tsha/ rgya chen chos kyi mdun sar bzhugs lags so/ /tsu tas+yakalpadarumabikramāti/ shin tu rnam gnon tsū ta'i dpag bsam ljon pa ni/ /āshwin+yimābartubibur+dhashākhā/ tha skar zla ba'i yal ga rnam par rgyas pa'i dus/ modābadzaphul+lasitadharmakoṇātra/ dkar phyogs dga' ba'i me tog bzhad tshe chos kyi grwa/ nalen+t+ra senad+datataṃsubhakati/ rgyun gyi dbang po'i sde nas dad pa'i sems kyis phul/ gcig zhus// // ༄༅/ /glo bo mkhan chen pa la phul ba'i zhu yig/ shrī swasti/ bsod nams bye ba'i dpal las legs bskrun sku/ /legs par bshad pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung / /zab gsal gnyis med rang byung lhun grub thugs/ /rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar bzang por 'dud/ /gang gi bka' yi glegs bum ni/ /go ro tsa na'i thum bu la/ /mu tra'i mtshan mar rab bkod nas/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar brtan par phebs/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i khur 'dzin cing / /spong bar gnas pa bdag cag kyang / /rje btsun mchog gi bka' drin las/ /'chad dang bsgom pa'i 'dun par mchis/ /da lan chab shog bstsal ba'i don/ /yid la nges par dam bcas te/ /rtse gcig sems zhing 'khod pa dang / /gnas su skabs babs phyin par bgyid/

/le kha gzigs pa'i mtshon byed du/ /tsi h+na'i ljon bzang lo ma yi/ /phur ma'i thum la tshom bu bkod/ /gus pas phul gyi bzhes su gsol/ /kun 'dzin snron zla'i dkar phyogs kyis/ /rta bdun bu mo'i khyim rgyu'i tshe/ /rig byed tshes la bsti gnas mchog dpal ldan mdo chod dag nas phul/ /gcig zhus// ༈ /glo bo mkhan chen la phul ba'i zhu yig/ na maḥlak+ṣ+mi ba nut+ta ra pā da s+yām+bu dza sam+bhak+ti/ bsod nams ye shes lhun grub sku/ pu ṇ+ya dz+nyā na sam+bho ga de/ legs gsung dam pa'i 'byung gnas mchog hā su bhā ṣa sastā ka ra/ ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal/ kā ṣa dh+wa dza dha ra la k+ṣ+mi/ bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud/ bha tra pā da pad+me na maḥ de ltar rab tu 'dud pa'i sh+lau ka sngon du brjod nas/ mchid du zhu ba ni/ sku gsung thugs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la rnyog pa'i dri ma med pa'i gdul bya rnams bskal ba bzang por mdzad pa'i skyabs nas/ chos mdzad bsod nams dpal 'bar ba dang / bla ma skye rtsa ba la gnang ba'i bka' shog snga rting go rim ma 'khrugs par rten bcas rgya gar gyi glegs bam zung / mgon po'i bstod pa bsgyur bcos byed rgyu sogs gnang ba phebs pa bzhin/ legs par rtog dpyod bgyis pa'i gsal cha rjes su 'bul lags/ bdag kyang rnam smin gyi lus bro nad med ngos/ kha ton chos kyi bshad nyan sogs tha snyad ma dor bar/ nā len+d+ra nas 'di phyogs su glo bur sleb dgos shar nas/ gnas pa lags shing / slar yang / sku'i rgyal mtshan brtan pa'i thabs la thugs brtson pa mi lhod pa dang / dngos cag spun 'khor bcas thugs dam gyi skyabs 'og nas mi 'bral ba'i bka' drin zhu/ gang dang ci'i zhib cha rjes su bgyid cing / da lan zhu yig spyan ras kyi 'tsho ba'i rten du/ rgyal bu kha thags la ba 'o 'byar ba 'bul/ dbo'i zla ba'i dmar cha rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya nas phul//

// ༈ /glo bo mkhan chen la phul ba'i zhu yig/ na maḥs de ba dza gargu ru bha tra bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka ma ho pā dh+ya ya rat+na pa de ma mi dai ha wān+ma ti bhik+ta ban+da na kraṃ taṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun mkhan chen rin po che'i zhabs la bdag lus ngag yid gsum shin tu gus pas 'dud par bgyi'o/ /ces gus pa'i tshig sngon du song nas thal mo sbyar te zhu ba/ rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs rtag par 'tsho zhing bzhes la/ 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams smin grol la 'god par mdzad pa'i zhabs 'phreng nas bka'i chab shog gser gyi glegs bum/ gu suṃ bha'i gnang sbyin bstsal ba tshangs pa'i yul sar son pas/ rab tu bde ba dang dga' ba'i dpal du gyur lags shing bdag kyang sgyu ma'i lus zung cha snyoms pa'i ngos nas/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa'i bka' bstsal pa ltar/ chos grwa 'dir/ dpyid chos kyi lam 'bras dang / rgyud kyi bshad nyan sogs gang shes bgyid kyi yod lags pa/ slar yang sku rin po che mchog tu brtan pa'i thabs lam la thugs rje brtson pa ma dor ba zhu zhing / rgyal ba'i bstan pa sgo du ma nas 'phel rgyas kyi phrin las mtha' yas pa dang / dngos cag rnams thugs rje'i skyabs 'og nas ma bral ba mkhyain/ chu 'phrul zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la phul/ gcig zhus// // ༈ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'jig rten gyi mig gcig zha lu lo chen la phul ba'i zhu yig 'jam dbyangs dges pa'i cod pan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sh+r+yi ā di nā tha budhū ya na mā mi/ lha dbang byang chub mkhyen mtsho las 'khrungs shing / /sam+bho ṭa yi rta ljang 'od zer gyis/ /nye bar bskrun pa'i gangs can dpal gcig po/ /rin chen chos skyong bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mang thos dge slong skad gnyis smra ba can/ /spong bar khas len sa skyar gnas pa yi/ /ā nan+da yis rtse gcig rab gus pas/ /snyim pa spyi bor sbyar nas 'di skad gsol/

/rdo rje'i sku la bgres rgud mi mnga' yang / /snyigs dus mig gi bdud rtsir bzhugs lags sam/ /'khrul med legs sbyar gsung de 'gag med kyang / /skal bzang rna ba'i dga' ston 'gyed lags drangs/ /mi 'gyur phyag rgya chen po'i ting 'dzin las/ /g.yo med zab gsal thugs de brtan lags sam/ /khyod kyi snyan grags zla ba'i cod pan ni/ /sa gsum dpal mgrin ral pa'i gtsug na mdzes/ /dam pa'i zhal bzang bdud rtsis legs 'tsho ba/ /snyoms las gyi nar gnas pa bdag cag kyang / /lus sems sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor rab brtan zhing / /zung 'jug lam bsgom 'chad cing bde bar mchis/ /'gro ba'i mi mchog rje btsun khyod nyid kyang / /thub dbang bstan pa'i dpal du zhabs brtan cing / /bdag cag 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams/ /lo brgyar thugs rje'i spyan gyis btsa' bar mdzod/ /de ltar gsol ba rtag tu 'debs lags na/ /mkhyen brtse'i chu gter gting mtha' mi mngon las/ /byin rlabs zla ba'i lag ma rab drangs te/ /blo bzang phan bde'i 'bras bu bskyed du gsol/ /ye shes spyan gyis sgrib med gzigs pa'i rten/ /dī shu gam tug+ma'ime tog la/ /rgya skyegs ze'u 'brur mu dra'i rkang drug pa/ /rnam rtser zlos gar sgyur ba 'di dbul lo/ /mi zad ces pa me khyi'i na chung ma/ /mī na'i khyim du rab zhugs ri bong can/ /skyes bu'i sbyor bas dga' ba rgyas pa'i tshes/ /bde stong mchog tu gyur tshe li khri taṃ// ༈ /e waṃ chos ldan gyi 'bul sdud pa rab 'byams pa dge 'dun dpal bzang la gdams pa// e ma 'khrul snang 'khor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la/ /skyes bu'i tshe srog ston kha'i sprin bzhin 'jig /dge sdig las 'bras nam yang bslu ba med/ /dam chos nyams len gyi rtsa ba 'di gsum che ba lags/ /nges 'byung byang chub kyi bsam pas kun slangs nas/ /lus lhar sgom ngag gi bzlas brjod brtson/

/yid ma bcos rang gsal dang dbyings bsres nas/ /'dren mchog bla ma 'bral med gtsug tu bsgom/ /ci mdzad khyed mkhyen gyi gdung bas gsol ba thob/ /rkyen gang shar sgyu ma'i rol rtsed la/ /zhen 'dzin a 'thas kyi rtog pas ma bcings par/ /spyod pa blang dor dang ldan pa 'di phyir bde/ /ces pa 'di yang e waṃ chos ldan gyi 'bul sdud pa rab 'byams pa dge 'dun dpal bzang la gnang ba'o/ /gcig zhus// // ༈ /zla grags la mus nas gnang ba// a po tsan+d+ra kirti a k+ṣa ra snyan dang ngags tshig gi skyes bcas 'phrod pas blo dga' da dung blo sna tshab tshub ma mang dpag bsam 'khri shing dag legs bris cig khyod kyi bla ma gang rnyed kun la kho bos bstod pa grub dus mi yongs khams le'i 'grel pa spyi don bstan pa'i rgya mtsho la sogs sa skya rang na bzhugs so mjal dus 'bul gyi pa yu ts+tshed zla grags 'gyod de mchis// ༈ /yang byas 'gyur nas gnang ba// kye ma log sred mun pa'i khrod na rgyu/ /ngan bsgom spyod pa'i cha shas kun nas rdzogs/ /gser gzugs ri bong mtshan mas spras pa'i phyir/ /mi khyod kyi ming ni zla ba grags/ /kha skyur dang ma bral za 'dod mkhan/ /yid g.yo rgyu'i bsam sbyor sna tshogs byed/ /smad khu ba'i nad kyi rtses pa yid/ /sngon las kyi 'phen pa yin na yang / /'phral dran pa'i brtsis kyi ma zin pa'i/ /khong khrims spyod rnams kyi chad pa bcad/ /blo 'gyod kyang cung zad 'chis pa 'dra/ /lar dal dus grogs med gcig bur dga'/ /lto ldum bu'i zas kyi 'tsho yong zhes/ /grogs gtam bcol ngan pas blo bsgyur nas/ /yul mnga' ris stod kyi zas nor dang / /las nag chang gnyis po phugs su zhen/ /de ldum bu'i spyod pa yin nam ang / /chos thos pa'i rnam grangs mang na yang / /don lag la long pa ji tsam bdog/ ༈ /lo pa spyan snga la gnang ba// ma hā ka l+yā ṇa mi tra a gra to lo tsa s+ya pā ṇau dā ne/

deng sang sku'i skye mched gsal/ /phyi nang rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ /thugs kyi spros pa 'jug bzhin nas/ /le kha dag yig sum rtags kyi/ /'grel pa'i dpe dang bris sku rnams/ /tshang mar 'phrod pas lut+sā na/ /nged cag bsnyen pa kha gso'i skabs/ /nyer 'tshe med cing bde bar rgyu/ /slar yang daṇ+ḍa'i ṭī ka dang / /mngon brjod sna tshogs gsal ba'i dpe/ /grangs tshang tshud zos med par bskur/ /phyis kyang myur 'gyogs de ltar 'tshal/ /yang phur la sogs bris thang 'ga'/ /byo ma a gra'i sṛts+tshar mchis/ /bai shā kha mā sa ti thi sap+ta bing+sha ti li khi ho// ༈ /lo pa spyan snga la gnang ba/ na ma shrī mañdzu nā thā ya/ /sarba dz+nyā yu badz+ra men+d+ra tsas maṃ sū traṃ pra kāshā+-itrashāṃ shūn+yātā karuṇāṃd+w+yenamanabān+nānan+tadz+nyeyaṃsramaḥ shīlādhish+tsasamādhidhīḥ pradhanabāṃbaimak+ṣ+yobidz+nyanakaṃ bishwādharmakabāh+yamadh+yikaguraubaid+mañdzunāthodzayaḥthams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal tshab mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung rnams mnyam nyid gsal bar gzigs/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med thugs ldan mtha' yas shes bya'i tshogs kun rab tu mkhyen/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab nor ldan rnam par grol dang ye shes spyan/ /phyi dang nang gi sna tshogs chos kun rig pa'i 'jam mgon bla ma rtag tu rgyal/ shashadharamibashubh+raṃkhad+gapustāṃkapāṇiṃ/ surutsiramatishan+taṃpañtsatsīraṃkumāraṃ/ pṛthuratiwaramok+ṣoṃpad+mapat+r+yatūk+ṣaṃ/ kumatidahanak+ṣaṃmañdzughoṣaṃṇāmyaḥbṛt+ta bco lnga pa shin tu nus ldan la lnga las/ bzhi pa phreng ldan ma'i sdeb sbyor yin/ gcig zhus// ༈/na maḥpra dza swasti nā tha ya/ /lār+ye shipaṭush+tsasir+dha lasamaṃshreyan+sa.en+sa.ekāyataṃ sarbadz+nyāmunibār shāsan sunirdīr+ghenadīpakaraṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye dgu bde legs su mgon po la/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi mnyam med mkhas dang grub pa kun gyi gtso bo gcig tu gang de nyid/ /kun mkhyen thub pa mchog gi bstan pa dri med ring du rgyas mdzad mar me mdzad dpal sras/

pauṣ+ṭiṃkārakushālamitrabikṝḍaṃdzāyā karāpād siṃhekhaṭ+wedzayashīladīp+t+yashabāgīshwāradharmekataṃ/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhabs kyi pad+ma rtag brten dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul khrims 'bar zhes pa'i/ /seng ge'i khri la rnam par brtson pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa rab tu rgyal// ༈ /lo dgon pa'i spyan snga la gnang ba'i bka' shog 'phrin yig dang po'i bu mo snyan tshig mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'byin pa zhes bya ba rtag rnam par brtson pa'i sdeb sbyor/ bāhushrutebhābamanenasarbāḥ par+yābadātaṃdzayabādi.an+taṃ/ bātsash+tsa.āram+bhas+d+yānakhaṭā+e/ saubhāṣ+thaswarashaubhami tri mang du thos shing bsam dang bsgom pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun la legs sbyangs nas/ /tshul bzhin 'chad dang rtsom pa'i khrir 'khod ste/ /legs bshad mgrin pa'i dbyangs ldan dge ba'i bshes/ yas+yak+ṣarāhaṃsabadhūnitatāṃ/ /mṛdū btsanāsumṛdūmanahā/ /rakamṛdād+gikishānaḥ dharmākasturbābarabhūmigāto/ nye dbang rdo rje sdeb sbyor gang gi phrin yig dang ba'i bu mo ni/ /snyan tshig spu sdug 'jam legs yid 'phrog pa'i/ /mgrin pa'i rdza rnga phyogs su 'byin mkhas pa/ /chos kyi 'dun pa dam por phyin pa lags/ gcig zhus// ༈ /sgra tshad pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la gnang ba// sgra tshad lo tsā dkon rgyal gyis/ /le kha 'phrod cing dbyangs sogs kyi/ /phyag phyir brtson pa shin tu legs/ /slar yang brtson pa cher bskyed nas/ /zla gcig tsam la 'dir bsleb dgos/ /lan 'phrod byung tshe thog med shog /nged kyang lam 'bras rgyud 'chad la/ /ngal ba med pa'i brtson par gnas/ /gtsang phyogs grags dbang 'khor bcas brdzangs/ /sa skya snar thang e waṃ dang / /thub bstan rnam rgyal bya rgod bshongs/ /chos 'khor la sogs rtse gdong skor/ /dgon pa rnams su mang bkol dang / /mgon khang so sor gtor sgrub kyi/ /yo byad khyer nas song ba lags/ /sa ga'i nyer bdun dgongs char bris//

༈ /byang pa dbon po rin bzang la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnyis// na maḥshrī mañdzu badz+ra ya/ yas+yaprabartaṃmunishasanaṃ/ sam+pūr+ṇaṇa bhik+ṣupripiṭākarat+nakoṣaṃdh+robhadraka.asanaika dh+yonat+tames+d+yāshubhanit+yabhon+tu/ gang gi snyun dri'i le kha dang / /dwi hi gser zho do ma'i me tog bcas/ /pho nya dpung pa'i yal 'dab las/ /thub pa'i bstan la rab zhugs dge slong gang / /yongs rdzogs sde snod gsum gyi rin chen mdzod/ /nye bar bzung nas bzang po'i bstan pa la/ /brtse gcig bsam gtan mchog gnas rtag tu dge /kho bo'i sabhar bsam pa'am legs par phyin/ /khyod nyid lus kyi 'tsho ba dag /ches cher rtas shing bde ba dang / /dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la/ /rtag 'grus sbyor ba mi dman par/ /dh+ya na gā rar bsam gtan khang bur g.yo med gnas/ /ces pa'i gtam de snying la 'ba'/ /shrī bān+bhu dpal ldan sa skyar mir gnas pa yi/ /dge slong skad gnyis smra ba gang / /mi rtag 'khor ba'i chu srin dag /mthong bas kun du skrag gyur te/ /ri ngogs stong pa'i bas mtha' 'dir/ /zab mo'i ting 'dzin bsgom pa la/ /nir+shai thi li su khaṃ s+d+yā/ /da ni snyigs ma'i dus gyur pas/ /bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams kyang gshegs/ /chos byed dkon la nyer 'tshe mang / /thos bsam byed rnams g.yeng bas brel/ /ting 'dzin bsgom rnams 'du 'dzin khyer/ /'ga' zhig tshe 'di'i che thabs bsgrub/ /'jig rten khrel dang ngo tsha bor/ /gang la ltas kyang skyo ba skye/ /de bas brtson 'grus lcags thob la/ /'gyur med bde ba'i btsan sa bzung / /dngos kyang dbyar 'di lam 'bras sogs/ /rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed gzhung rnams/ /'chad pa'i tha snyad la 'bad snyam/ /nyid rang sngar bzhin 'tsho rtsis dang / /nges don mchog la rab gzhol bas/ /skabs babs gzhan don khur khyer nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la phan par mdzod/ /nged kyi bla gos 'di nyid kyang /

/khyed kyi bar chad sel ba dang / bsam don bde blag 'grub pa'i phyir/ /phur ma ba 'o 'byar ba yod/ /chu zla dmar cha bzang po'i tshes/ /gnyis par byas 'gyur rdo rje'i kṛt+m+yurku li sha /shai la gu hār brag phug myur bar bris// ༈ /swasti rastu/ bshes gnyen rat+na bha dra gang de yi/ /le kha kho bo'i dpe dang rgya tsha sman/ /mu dra'i thig le ma nyams legs par byin/ /hiṅgul jo bo'i sku la myur du 'bul/ /lus sems ngal dub med par rab bgrod nas/ /mjal 'os kun dang phebs pa'i gtam bgyis te/ /slar yang ting 'dzin khang bu'i nang zhugs nas/ /zab don rnal 'byor bsgom la lhag par spro/ /dngos kyang sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor nyer brtas shing / /rim gnyis bsgom la rtag 'grus thun 'tshams su/ /kha ton chos spyod gtor ma'i rim pa rnams/ /mi g.yel lhod pa med pa'i tshul du lags/ /snyigs dus skye bo gzhan skyon kho na rtog /kho bos rang skyon rtog la nan tan bgyis/ /gzhan dag bskur pa 'debs la shin tu spro/ /nged gyi mtho dman kun la dag snang sbyangs/ /'ga' zhig yon tan gang yod kha ru 'don/ /bdag gi yon tan cung zad rting du sbas/ /la la spyod tshul mdzes pa gtso bor byed/ /kho bos nang gi dul la ched gnyer byas/ /phal cher phyi rol sdom la bzang por rloms/ /ngos kyis nang gi sdom la gces spras bzung / /gzhan dag tha snyad tshig la mi tshe skyel/ /nged kyi gnas lugs bsgom pa gtso bor byas/ /kha cig bar chad che la yon tan blta/ /bdag gi chung ngu lam khyer che la bros/ /mdor na bslab bya'i gnang bkag tha dad rnams/ /theg pa che chung gong 'og sna tshogs las/ /kho bos theg pa'i yang rtse rdo rje theg /gtso bor bgyis shing de rjes byang sems kyi/ /smon 'jug bslab bya dag la nan tan byas/ /theg dman bslab bya'ang gtso bor rtsa bzhi bsrung / /phra mo'i bslab pa cung zad nyams srid na/

/sdom ldan mchog gsum spyan sngar mnong pas bshags/ /nyid rang sngar bzhin nges don rnal 'byor mchog /bsgom pa gtsor gyis thun 'tshams ngag bzlas sogs/ /lus ngag dge ba gang 'grub 'bad stsol gyis/ /dus ngan spyod pa 'di la kyag gtad med/ /khrums zla'i dmar cha bug zla'i tshes la bris// ༈ /thub bstan rnam rgyal ba'i gdan sa ba la gnang ba la// pra ṇa ba/ rab 'byams gzhung la thogs med blo gros can/ /rab yangs brtse ba'i gting mtha' mi mngon pa'i/ /rab mchog dge ba'i bshes khyod gangs can 'dir/ /rab mang 'chad dang brtsom pa'i dbang po rgyal/ /gang gi phrin shog ngang pa'i bu mo ni/ /mkhas mang pad+ma'i mtsho 'dir legs phyin pas/ /blo gsal chu skyar gzhon nu'i tshogs rnams kyang / /'dzum phreng ge sar ci yang ston pa snyam/ /legs bshad dga' ston don gnyer 'dus pa la/ /rnam mang drang nges so sor 'byed mkhas pa'i/ /tshig don 'chad la ngal ba'i khur bzod khyed/ /gzhung brgya dus su 'dom la mi g.yel bar/ /kā ṣā dh+wa yi khengs ldan rnam dpyod kyis/ /rnam mang gsung rab kun la legs sbyangs ched/tha snyad tshig gi sdebs sbyor sgro 'dogs rnams/ /nye bar spyod pa'i bshes gnyen mtha' yas la/ /ches cher bsngags pa'i da sha pa ti'i bu/ /gzhon nu'i lang tsho yon tan nor bu'i phreng / /do shal ldan yang phyogs 'dir ches dkon nas/ /brgya phrag 'bad pa'i ngal ba lhur blangs pa/ /ched du gtad pa'i don gnyer ma yin mod/ /skabs 'gar sngags kyi tshul la'ang legs gzhug phyir/ /lak+ṣ+yab+dhi dang bi bā ha gnyis kyis/ /nan tan yang yang tshig gi lcag btab nas/ /nor 'dzin thig le 'di yang myur bskyod na/ /ut+pa ha'i dpal la nyer spyod 'gyur/ /gang phyir nor bu rin chen gling dag tu/ /mching bu'i tshogs la rlom sems ci ltar skye/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i gsan pa mthar phyin khyod/ /da dung rgyan gyi bstan bcos daṇ+ḍi sogs/ /'dren byed bdud rtsir gyur na ci ma lags/

/'brug zla ces pa rgya nang rtsis lugs kyis/ /bod rgan tha snyad sbyar ba'i brda yin kyang / /'phags yul mkhas pa'i gzhung la ma bshad phyir/ /chen por rloms rnams brtag dpyad bya bar rigs/ /mi bzad bar+ṣa'i na chung gsar pa ni/ /tsi dra mā sā'i rin chen rgyan phreng can/ /dmar cha'i gos bzang lhab lhub cher g.yo ba/ /bkra shis phyogs kyi zur mig 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /dal 'gro'i skyes phran lha 'tshams bu mo dang / /lhan cig me ṣa'i khyim du rgyu ba'i dus/ /ngag gi dbang pos byin rlabs paṇ+ḍu ka /grub pa'i gnas nas dge bar li khi taṃ/ /ma hā tsihar+bho bā da ta ne tra lu trā p+ti// ༈ /rab 'byams pa kun dga' tshe brten la gnang pa'i bka' shog sid+dha rastu/ rab 'byams kun dga'i le kha dang / /nam zla'i bzhes spro mam+sa ni/ /ma su ni yi skyes dang bcas/ /legs par 'phrod pas rab tu dga'/ /ro 'dzin dbang po tshim pa dang / /lus kyi dpal mo'ang brtas par 'gyur/ /nyid cag lus sems bde ba'i ngos/ /kha ton bzlas brjod 'phel gyur taṃ/ /dngos kyang sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /skyod pa yang zhing rim gnyis kyis/ /rnal 'byor mchog la mi lhod par/ /ci bder rgyu zhing gnas pa lags/ /nyid rang chos 'brel yod pa yi/ /bla ma rnams la bzang ngan dang / /'dor len med pa'i mos gus bsgom/ /sangs rgyas rgyu yi gtso bo mchog /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /thun gyi 'tshams dang dngos gzhi'i dus/ /yang yang nan tan gyis la soms/ /bskyed rim nga rgyal rnam pa gsal/ /dran pas 'phral du gsal 'debs gyis/ /thun re'i 'go la lam zab kyis/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor chag med bsgoms/ /de ltar byas nas lhag pa'i lhar/ /bla ma rang sems dbyer med du/ /shes tshe byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug /sangs rgyas kun gyi dus drug tu/ /g.yel med sems can la gzigs kyang / /mos gus gdung ba'i 'brel med na/ /las ngan de dag skyob mi nus/

/lan gyi mtshon byed rkang 'thung gi/ /dbang po'i 'bras bu ro bcud can/ /me yi grangs la ba 'o yis/ /nye bar brgyan pa 'di springs so/ /gro bzhin zla ba'i nyer lnga la/ /dpal ldan sa skya lo tsās bris/ /rang gzhan dge ba 'phel gyur cig/ ༈ /smin drug pa la gnang ba// swasti dharma dha tu ma hā su kha pra t+yak+ṣa bo dh+yan+tu/ rje btsun mkhyen pa'i dbang po mchog /thugs rje'i chu 'dzin rab ldan pa/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā gang / /ma hā lo tsā'i zhabs brten pa/ /phyi nang rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ /sngon gyi legs byas mthu grub pa'i/ /rnam dpyod gsal ba'i 'od kyi phreng / /btsun chung skyogs kyi lo tsā ba/ /sa skya'i dge slong rigs sngags 'chang / /'chi med 'od gsal kun dga' yi/ /skabs mchid gser gyi phreng mdzes 'di/ /le kha'i srad bur rgyu bar bya/ /bde chen sa yi thig le nas/ /phyogs der bzhud rjes lus zung gi/ /'tsho ba ches cher brtan pa dang / /dran pa'i ka ba rab rgyas nas/ /ga pur gtsug tor do shal gyis/ /sgyu skar phreng ba skyangs byed pa/ /dges rgyur spyod pa'i dpal ldan rnams/ /dngos kyang gtsang phyogs ljongs rgyu'i skabs/ /dus ngan 'khrug pa'i rnam 'gyur la/ /skyo sun med par 'dus byas te/ /rang gi bsti gnas dam pa 'dir/ /lnga phung bro nad mi 'tshal zhing / /zab mo ting 'dzin rab bsgrubs nas/ /slar yang mgon po bi rū pa'i/ /gsung ngag snyan brgyud 'doms pa dang / /'ga' zhig brda sprod byed pa'i gzhung / /nye bar bstan pa'i tha snyad tsam/ /a ti san+ti tshul du mchis/ /sa bdag dge dbang gis mdzad pa'i/ /dpag bsam 'khri shing yal 'dab rnams/ /mig gi bdud rtsir bgyis pa'i tshe/ /lo chung khyod kyi rnam dpyod dang / /lag pa'i 'du byed ches dran nas/ /'dren byed mchi ma'i ngur smrig gis/ /dge sbyong zol du gnas pa lags/ /so sor 'gyes dus smras pa'i tshig /dran pa'i yi dam brtan byos la/

/ched du gtad bya ma gcig dang / /'di dang lhan cig khyod nyid kyang / /brtson pa'i lcag gis bskul byas nas/ /phyogs 'dir myur du bgrod pa yi/ /cang shes gom pa'i stobs bskyed de/ /rtse gcig 'dun pa ci nas kyang / /e h+ye e h+yi ar+k+ṣa/ /cal col rtse mo'i bzhad cha dang / /bsres nas yal yol ma byed par/ /don dam yin no grogs mchog kye/ /lib+ta lta ba'i brten tsam du/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi ka pā ṭa/ /yug la ba 'o brgyan pa 'di/ /mi zad lhun po'i rtse mo nas/ /nya khyim nam mkha'i nor bu mchog /dkar phyogs dga' ba'i pad tshal la/ /rnam rtsen gang ba'i tshes la bris// // ༈ /gdong dga' ba kun spangs tshe ring grags pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog/ swasti/ kun spangs tshe ring grags pa yis/ /le kha bsngo ba'i brten bcas pa/ /pho nya zung gi lag sor las/ /rim par brgyud de gnas 'dir phyin/ /dngos kyang sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ /bde zhing zab mo'i rnal 'byor la/ /mi ngal brtson pa'i khur ldan par/ /spong ba'i gnas 'dir rgyu zhing mchis/ /sa skya'i dgon gnas 'di'ang ma nyams tsam/ /yong du re ba'i 'dun pa mi dman kyang / /dus dang sems can bskal pa'i shugs skyod pas/ /mig tsam lhag mar lus la'ang dus mi ring / /'on kyang rje btsun thugs rje'i chu gter las/ /nam zhig phan bde zla ba'i lhag ma ni/ /nor 'dzin 'gro ba'i rtsa lag du 'gyur snyam/ /yid gnyis 'khyog la 'chang zhing gnas ba lags/ /na tshod gzhon zhing blo gros rgan/ /thos dang bsam pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /nye bar gnas pa'i rab 'byams te/ /mi rtag gyur pa gces mos kyang / /'dus byas kun gyi mtha' lags pas/ /son par gnas pa'ang de ltar dgongs/ /rang gzhan 'di phyir bde ba'i thabs/ /lus kyi 'tsho brtsis rnam dkar gyi/ /las la rtag tu 'grus pas na/ /myur du 'phrad pa'i dga' ston bgyi/ /rta ljang bu mo'i khyim brtson pa'i/ /bha tra ti thi li kha taṃ/

/bzang po'i tshes la bris pa'o// // ༈ /lhun rtse'i mkhan po thams cad mkhyen pa la// swasti/ bslab gsum ngur smrig gos ldan zhing / /rim gnyis zab mo'i lang tsho rgyas/ /nges don blta ba'i 'thon mthing spyan/ /ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa rgyal/ /bde legs gā tha rab brjod nas/ /skabs don khams bde mchid 'di gsol/ /nyid sku dpag bsam ljon pa yang / /ser bu'i rlung gis ma skyod dam/ /gang gsung ka la bing ka de/ /'khrul pa'i nyes pas ma gos sam/ /khyod thugs lugs gnyis mkhyen pa can/ /rnyog pa'i dri mas rab dben nam/ /nged cag rgyal khams pa rnams kyang / /rnam smin 'byung ba ma 'khrugs shing / /dge sbyor chos kyi 'chad rtsom la/ /rtag tu 'grus pa'i khur dang ldan/ /slar yang sa yi thig le der/ /myur du bgrod snyam yod na'ang / /phyogs kyi skal bas lo shas la/ /cung zad rgyu ba'i bgegs su gyur/ /khyed sku mi 'gyur brtan par 'tsho ba dang / /skabs 'gar gzhan la 'chad dang bsgom pa sogs/ /chos dang 'jig rten rgyal srid bya ba la/ /brtson pas legs nyes kun du gzigs par mdzod/ /nged kyi slob ma bhik+ṣu 'khor bcas rnams/ /grwa dgon dge 'dun mang ja zhu ba dang / /singha rā dza'i sku la bsnyun dri'i ched/ /rkang gtad brdzangs pa bslab bya ston par mdzod/ /le kha gzigs phyir 'chi med gū li dang / /ma hā tsih+na'i ljon bzang lo 'dab mchog /kar+pa ṭa'i phur ma ba 'o can/ /sa ga dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i tshes la bris/ /dharma swā mi wā ge sha dharma kīrti shrī bha dra s+ya sar+b+ba pak+ṣe ṣu shu bhon+tu/ /chos kyi rje ngag gi dbang po chos kyi grags pa dpal bzang po phyogs thams cad du dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ /'di 'dol ka'i rgyal po udz+nya de ba la gnang ba'i bka' shog/ oṃ swasti/ na masatri rat+na sh+tsa gu ru bh+yaḥ lo ka pā la ra dzo dz+nya de ba ba ta/ k+ṣe ma ku sa la r+dh-i ya n+te yā pa yan+ti/ lo ka kā rāsh+tsit+ta pra ba ha ra oṃ bde legs su gyur cig

/dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten skyong ba rgyal po u dz+nya de ba nyid/ /sku khams bzang ba dang dge bas 'tsho zhing bzhes nas/ 'jig rten bya ba la thugs gzhol bar bzhugs lags/ tismi te shru te nā prat+so ba prap+taḥzhes thos pas yid kyi spro ba thob/ a ha me pi ya thā su kha dzi ba gam+bhi ra yo gā dhi bar+dhasti/ bdag kyang bde bas 'tsho zhing zab mo'i rnal 'byor lhag par 'phel bar mchis/ punañtsa kā ya ma nas shu bha su kha dzi baṃ pā da dṛ r+ha ba tu/ slar yang lus dang yid bde bas 'tsho zhing zhabs brtan par mdzod/ ha me shak+tsi bur+dha bha dra sa khi daṃ/ kho bo'i slob ma sangs rgyas bzang po grogs mched/ dha na pa la to la ka re dza ho ya s+ya ka l+ya ṇa bha wa tu/ nor tshong byed par song ba/ gang legs kyi grogs mdzod/ ak+ṣa ra dha ṣa ma hā tsi na ne tra mu drasti/ yi ge gzigs pa'i brten/ rgya nag chen po'i dar la rgyas btab pa phul/ i ti in+t+ra nā ma saṃ wa r+sa ra phalgu nā ma sa kṛṣ+ṇa pak+ṣa dwi ya ti li khi taṃ/ 'di dbang po zhes pa'i lo nag pa zla ba'i nag phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la bris// ༈ /rgyal rtse ba la gnang ba// na ma shrī mañdzu gho ṣā nā thā ya/ dpal mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab rgyas bsod nams bye ba'i dpal gyis kun nas mdzes shing dpag yas ye shes tshogs la mnga' 'byor dkon mchog rin chen bslu med bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rab brtan rin chen rdul brtsegs lhun po mchog dang dri med 'od zer che 'bar tsan+ti ma ṇi ka nyid mi bzad gter gyi bum bzang dpag bsam shing / /rab brjid 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rin chen bai ḍūr+ya dang khyim bdag btsun mo glang chen 'chang gang myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan kāṇ+ḍa la sogs pa'i/ /rab mang srid dang zhi ba'i dpal yon mtha' dag gcig tu 'dzoms pa'i legs byas mthu yis mi dbang gang de yun ring rgyal zhing bkra shis brtan gyur cig

/swasti kā tha nye bar brjod nas/ dpal sa chen po la dbang bsgyur ba'i nus ldan dbang po 'di zhes bya ba'i sku'i dpag bsam bsod nams kyi rtsa ba ches cher brtan zhing / khrims gnyis gser gyis lo 'dab phyogs kun tu rgyas pa'i ngang nyid kho nar bde ba dang / dges par spyod bzhin pa'i ro bcud rnam par dro ba'i 'bras bus khur chen pos lhag par rab tu brjid pa dang / kun tu lhun chags pa'i rnam 'gyur g.yo zhing / sngon rabs mdzes pa'i chos rgyal chen po rnams kyi mdzad pa'i ngang tshul ngo mtshar gyi dpal la 'gran pa bzod pa'i phrin las kyi kha lo sgyur bar gdan chags sam/ /rje btsun dam pa sa skya pa'i chos khrir gnas pa rang nyid cag kyang / rdo rje'i lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlab pa la/ tha mal gyi kun tu rtog pa dang / gzung 'dzin kun btags kyi 'khrul pa mtha' dag rgyangs ring du spangs nas dben pa'i gnas su mnyam gzhag ting nge 'dzin dang / rjes thob gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod yun ring du bgyis te/ nye dus dbyar chos dang / badz+ra kī la ya'i sgrub mchod sogs bsgrubs nas/ gsung ngag rin po che'i gzhung khrid legs par tshugs pa'i rnam dkar gyi bya ba 'phel rgyas su gnas pa de lags/ der rgyal srid chen po'i gser gyi khri thog tu legs par phebs pa'i dga' ston 'bul bar/ drag po rdo rje brdzangs pa lags pa/ slar sku'i 'tsho thabs la mi g.yel ngos/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag 'phel rgyas kyi 'khur bzhes nas/ dbus gtsang byin bde 'jags kyi thabs mkhas dang / khyad par de pa rang gi zhal ngo rim par byon pa rnams kyi mdzad srol bzang po 'dug pa ltar/ gdan sa chen po 'di nyid la gces spras su mdzad pa'i zhabs tog dang dos pa che bar mdzad 'tshal/ 'dir yang sku'i rim 'gro srung 'khor dang / smon lam legs par bgyid pa yod lags shing / thung pa ngag tu 'bul/

shrī rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon po brgyud par bcas/ /dbyer med yi dam chos srung lha yi tshogs/ /dbang gi lha dang nor bdag tshogs rnams kyis/ /mi dbang 'khor bcas rtag tu dges par mdzod/ /rnam 'gyur gyi lo karka ṭa'i zla ba'i phyogs pūr+ṇaṇa mā s+yaṃ li khi taṃ shu bhaṃ// // ༈ /rgyal rtse ba la gnang ba// shrī ā yu de wa ma sha ra ṇaṃ gats+tsha mi/ dpal tshe'i lha la skyabs su mchi/ gang zhig 'jig rten 'di na ches dkon mchog gsum gyi/ /zhabs rten 'dab brgya'i rdul la gtsug gi nor bus mngon reg pa/ /chos srid gser gyi khri la rab tu brtan pa'i nus ldan dbang po mchog /dpal dang 'byor pa'i lang tsho phun tshogs gang de yun du 'dzom zhing bde gyur cig /bshis brjod dar gyis srad bu la rgyus pa'i/ /snyan ngags me tog mdzes pa'i phreng ba 'di/ /yid 'ong chos rgyal gzhon nu la 'bul gyis/ /'chi med gu li phyogs gnyis zla ba'i grangs/ /rnam dkar spungs pa'i yal 'dab rab bskyod de/ /'dzum zer kun tu dges pa'i rol rtsed kyis/ /phyogs bcur snyan pa'i grags pa khyab gyur cig /chu 'phrul dga' ba dang po'i tshes la phul/ maṅga laṃ ṇa bha wan+tu/ gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ rgya nag rgyal po la phul ba'i zhu yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
